_comment: Recorded TTS-cadence baseline for voice_cadence_guard. The band is an UPPER bound on rhythm disorder: an evenly-paced spoken stream (Flue 1.x, or the Flue-2.x stream after routers/voice_tts._pace_delivery) stays inside it; the pre-fix bursty 2.x stream does not. Refresh with scripts/perf/measure_tts_cadence.py --update-baseline on the live box, then decide explicitly (an operator ear check, since no automated gate hears rhythm).
source: Flue 1.x :3578 even-cadence reference; measured wire-1 emit gaps ~200-1200ms, rush_fraction 0.0, gap_cv ~0.5
